messages.author: 0eb5a09fd4de9e5e
messages.subject: Re: checkpoint and bioconductor
parts:
Hi, Tao

We are not actively working on this, although the request is on the wish list: https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/checkpoint/issues/179

If this is urgent for you, perhaps you can join the project and help to add this functionality?  We have some ideas on how this might work.

Regards

Andrie
